user.title: Connect to your Autel charger
user.description: Enter the charger's local HTTPS address and web login PIN. Certificate verification is off by default for the charger's self-signed certificate. Setup only reads settings; it does not start or stop charging.

reconfigure.title: Change charger connection
reconfigure.description: Leave PIN Code blank to keep the saved PIN. The address must belong to the same charger.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to your charger again
reauth_confirm.description: The charger rejected the saved credentials. Enter its current web login PIN.

error.invalid_auth: The charger rejected the username or PIN.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the charger. Check its address, HTTPS access, and certificate setting.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, optionally with an HTTPS port. Paths, credentials, and HTTP URLs are not supported.
error.invalid_response: The charger returned an unexpected or unsuccessful response.
error.unsupported_charger: This integration supports the verified single-connector AC MaxiCharger interface. This charger has a different connector layout or rating.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The address belongs to a different charger.

init.title: Polling settings
init.description:
Home Assistant automatically switches between charging and idle refresh rates. Requests run one at a time to reduce load on the charger.

Each interval is the wait after a refresh finishes. For example, a 10-second interval with a 4-second refresh gives roughly 14 seconds between refresh starts. Saving reloads the integration.

data_description.charging_interval: Refreshes charging status, vehicle connection, power, current, voltage and session readings using two requests. Recommended: 10 s; 5–15 s gives faster updates. Must be no longer than the idle interval.
data_description.status_interval: Used whenever the charger is not actively charging, including while a vehicle is plugged in but stopped. Recommended: 60 s. Starts made in the Autel app are detected on the next idle refresh; Home Assistant controls request immediate status readback.
data_description.details_interval: Adds five requests for the current limit, meter energy, phase/pilot readings, Autostart, network signal and CPU/memory/flash usage. Recommended: 120 s; use 300 s to reduce traffic. Must be at least as long as the idle interval. Current-limit changes made in Home Assistant request immediate readback.
data_description.request_timeout: Maximum time to wait for each individual HTTPS request. Recommended: 15 s; normal telemetry can take 2–3 s. Increase if requests time out on your Wi-Fi. This changes the time allowed for a reply, not the refresh rate.

error.details_too_fast: Set additional readings to the idle interval or longer.
error.charging_too_slow: Set charging refresh to the idle interval or shorter.
